items.statement: Final: competing N/O activation explains the N-site preference
items.expected: Finally, use actual comparable N/O bond-formation activation free energies and evidence for the target N product to explicitly conclude that the N channel is lower than the O channel within the investigated radical-pair model after nitrogen loss and hydrogen transfer, and apply this competition result to explain the given N-site preference. The authors' local barriers of 25.8/33.7 and O−N=7.9 kcal/mol are context; exact numerical agreement is not required. A reversed direction, lack of competition evidence or merely restating the product observation earns no credit. Scientifically equivalent methods/labels and evidence-supported physical explanations are allowed. Distinguish the conditional model from an experimentally unique mechanism; do not present unverified π–π/NCI causation, actual populations, ISC rates, irreversibility or the 72% yield as established conclusions.
